hard_calls: Stage 2 text departs from the source in several places; stage 3 cannot correct these, so they are flagged for stage 2: 'as it seems to me' is dropped from the Empiricist Attitude note; 'it' is replaced by 'pragmatism' in the Method Only note and the Corridor note; the clause 'much as the courtier type is frozen out in republics...' is cut from the Method Only note; 'in what I called in my last lecture' is cut from the same note; and 'So' is dropped from the start of the Solving Names note.
The hub's numbered list is kept. The order follows the lecture's own sequence, and a bullet list would need a colon lead-in that is not in the source, which would be a text change.

The sentence 'is what the pragmatic method means' in the Attitude of Orientation note defines the method, but the source names no rule, so no [!Info] callout is added (a callout title must come from the source).
The three 'with nominalism / utilitarianism / positivism' clauses in the Theories note are running prose, not an enumeration the source counts, so they are not made into a list.
